terra.problem: The statement that city gates were busy places adds an unreferenced Bible-world fact.
Calling the verse a sign for someone holding back at church applies it to a situation the text does not address.
The psalm mentions nations and peoples later, but does not call them enemies.
The psalm mentions beds, but does not say the shouting happens at bedtime.
Papa comments on his own joke choices instead of simply responding to the heavy passage.
The explanation calls the passage hard and then heavy, rather than saying once that the part is heavy.
The written judgment does not establish that the saints did not make up the judgment themselves.
The text says the judgment is written, but does not say whether the saints chose it.
